items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: In a historic first for Southern California, two olive ridley sea turtle nests were discovered in September 2026. items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: Archaeologists exploring Bure in northeastern France uncovered 28 ancient Gallic coins alongside human skull fragments. The discovery contributes to understanding the cultural and religious practices of ancient Gaul. Ongoing studies aim to clarify the site's history and purpose.
